newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan gold reserves at 13.75 mln ounces - Sheu.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan gold reserves at 13.75 mln ounces - Sheu.

text.p: Taiwan's gold reserves total 13.75 million ounces worth about US$4.7 billion at current values, Taiwan central bank governor Sheu Yuan-dong said on Thursday.
Sheu said Taiwan's foreign exchange reserves, the world's largest after Japan's and China's, stood at US$88.6 billion, up somewhat from the bank's official end-of-January report of US$88.393 billion.
Taken together, Sheu told parliament, the island of 21 million people was sitting on what he called "healthy" gold and foreign exchange reserves worth US$93.3 billion.
